newsitem.title: USA: Hoboken, N.J., names developer of south waterfront.
newsitem.headline: Hoboken, N.J., names developer of south waterfront.

text.p: Officials overseeing the Hoboken, N.J., South Waterfront Development project said Thursday they named SJP Properties of Parsippany to develop the first block of properties.

"We are creating an exciting new world-class complex of commercial, residential and recreational uses that will generate 7,000 new permanent jobs and will be a significant addition to the local and regional economy," Mayor Anthony Russo said in a statement announcing the move.
The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey is contributing $75 million to the project.
The South Waterfront is planned to be a mixed-use development of 2.3 million square feet of space next to the Hoboken train terminal.
